hints.lin.parallel.slopes: Parallel: the same slope. Perpendicular: flip the slope and change its sign (2 becomes −1/2).
hints.lin.parallel.equation: Find the new slope (same for parallel, flipped with the sign changed for perpendicular). Then put the point into y = mx + b to find b.
hints.lin.parallel: Parallel: same slope. Perpendicular: negative reciprocal. Then use the point to find b.

misconceptionMessages.lin.perp-for-parallel: Parallel lines never meet, so they go the same way: the SAME slope. Perpendicular lines meet at a right angle: flip and change the sign.
misconceptionMessages.lin.perp-no-negative: Flip it AND change the sign: perpendicular to 2 is −1/2, not 1/2. One line goes up, the other goes down.
misconceptionMessages.lin.perp-no-flip: Change the sign AND flip it: perpendicular to 2 is −1/2, not −2.
misconceptionMessages.lin.parallel-copied: The new line has its own y-intercept. Put the point into y = mx + b and solve for b.

sections.title: Parallel and perpendicular slopes
sections.objective: Find parallel and perpendicular slopes, and tell which a pair of lines is.
explain: Parallel lines never meet: they have the same slope (and different y-intercepts).
Perpendicular lines meet at a right angle: their slopes are negative reciprocals, so they multiply to −1.
sections.key: Parallel: the same slope. Perpendicular: flip the slope and change its sign (2 and −1/2 multiply to −1).

sections.title: A line through a point
sections.objective: Write the line through a point parallel or perpendicular to another.
explain: First the new slope: the same for parallel, the negative reciprocal for perpendicular.
Then the point gives b: put it into y = mx + b and solve.
sections.key: New slope first (same, or flip and change the sign). Then put the point into y = mx + b to find b.

sections.title: Putting it together
sections.key: Parallel: same slope. Perpendicular: negative reciprocal. Then the point gives b.
